content:
I made my 3D gallery code public today. It's called Relay Gate.

Right now it reads an artist's website and pulls in the work. Next it will hang that work in a gallery you can walk through, with gates to other artists' galleries, over Nostr.

Early days, MIT licensed.
https://github.com/timothyjosephmurphy/relaygate

Walk my gallery: https://tjm.art/play
